decisionsTitle: A member's number: the race's background with its own header, and a member mark
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13:** «și BIB-uri, trebuie încă o setare pentru membrii BVR, trebuie să aibă ceva bifă, nu doar background, cel mai probabil nu vor avea alt background, ci doar alt header și încă o bifă».

**Decision.** Amends §664 (the members' number) and §695 (its background); §735's format and the numbering are untouched.

- **The race's own background, a header of their own.** The members' background choice already had the means: «Top band only» is the ordinary number with the members' header and label, and nothing under it changes. It is now named for what the club wants — «Același fundal ca restul numerelor — doar antet propriu» ("Same background as the other numbers — own header only") — and its help says so in one line. No third style value: it would draw exactly what `band` draws. Every stored design reads as it did.
- **The member mark.** A new tick in the members' object, `member.mark`, «Semn de membru pe număr» («Member mark on the number»), off by default, so every stored design reads as today. On, every member's number — and only a member's, and only while the members' number is on — carries a ring with a check mark in it: on the PDF sheet (members' pile included), on the picture (the bibs page and the desk) and in the editor's preview. It sits at the card's left inset, 12 points under the header's foot, 26 points across with a 2.4-point stroke — beside the number and the name rather than over them: the number is centred and at least 100 points clear of the inset even at five digits, the name is centred and cut well before it — in the number's own ink (white on the whole card, the body ink on white), never a colour literal. It is drawn as vector strokes from one set of points (`MEMBER_MARK_CHECK`) by both renderers, so no font has to carry a glyph and the sheet and the picture cannot differ; it reads at A5 and at half of it.
- **The editor.** Everything the members' number decides sits under «Membrii primesc un număr cu design propriu» through `OnlyWhenTicked` (hidden, still posted), the preview with it, and the mark's tick has its one-line «Bifat: … Debifat: …» help in both languages. The mark travels in the preview's address as `memberMark`, so the picture's address — and its cache — changes with it.
- **No migration.** `events.bib_design` is a JSON column read through `readBibDesign`; a design without the key reads `mark: false`.

**Refused.** A mark in a font glyph (the sheet's fonts may not carry it, and the picture's would differ); a mark over the number; a separate switch for the picture and the sheet.
changelogLine: - **A member's number keeps the race's background and gets a mark** — «Același fundal ca restul numerelor» (own header only) is named in the editor, and the tick «Semn de membru pe număr» puts a check mark on every member's number, in the picture, the PDF sheet, the desk and the members' pile. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the members' number on with «Semn de membru pe număr» ticked, then every member's number — on the PDF sheet, the picture, the desk's picture and the members' pile — carries a ring with a check mark at the card's left inset under the header, in the number's own ink, drawn from one set of points by both renderers, and an ordinary number, a spare and any number while the members' number is off carry none; unticked, which every design stored before the key reads as, nothing is drawn (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A design saved before the member mark existed reads `member.mark` as false and the members' background as it was; the mark travels in the preview's address as `memberMark` and is read back by the same schema, so the picture's address changes when the tick does; the editor shows the members' fields, the mark's tick included, only while «Membrii primesc un număr cu design propriu» is ticked (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
